definitions.gloss: hanging advertisement in a train; overhead transit ad
definitions.explanation: An advertisement poster hung from the ceiling of a train car, positioned at eye level for standing passengers. A distinctive feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中吊|なかづ}り⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a hanging advertisement in the train.

examples.english: A hanging ad for a weekly magazine caught my eye.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A distinctive feature of Japanese trains. The posters are hung from horizontal bars near the ceiling, hanging at a height visible to standing passengers. Weekly magazines, new books, and event announcements are common subjects. The term is short for {中吊|なかづ}り⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中吊|なかづ}り⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ (hanging transit advertisement — full form)
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中吊|なかづ}り (train hanging ad)
- {中吊|なかづ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to run a hanging ad)
